In comparison with the National average Male Female ratio of 61 : 39, this ratio was almost altered to 40 : 60 in case of Mass/Family Suicides. | Rate of Suicides, i.e. number of suicides per one lakh of population, has been widely accepted as a standard measure of yardstick. The All India rate of suicides was 10.6 during the year as compared to 10.8 during 2000. Pondicherry reported the highest rate of suicide (54.3) followed by Andaman & Nicobar Islands (36.2), Kerala (30.1), Tripura (26.8) and Dadra and Nagar Haveli (22.7).
